grammar.summary: 本课学习 manage to do 与 threaten 的搭配。

points.title: manage to do 表成功做到
points.explanation: He managed to escape = 设法做到了（成功）；try to do 只是尝试，未必成功。对比记忆。

examples.en: He managed to climb into the mouth of the volcano.

points.title: threaten to do 威胁将做
points.explanation: threaten to erupt / He threatened to leave. 主语可以是人也可以是自然现象。

examples.en: The volcano threatened to erupt at any moment.
